statement: MeromorphicAt f (g x)) (hg : AnalyticAt 𝕜 g x) (hg_nc : ¬EventuallyConst g (𝓝 x)) : meromorphicOrderAt (f ∘ g) x = (meromorphicOrderAt f (g x)) * (analyticOrderAt (g · - g x) x).map Nat.cast
